## Summary

Explain the user-facing or technical change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the focused tests for this change.
- [ ] I confirmed the existing interface and workflows still behave as expected.
- [ ] I did not commit generated build output, local databases, private workbooks, or machine-specific files.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for secrets, tokens, personal data, unsafe logs, and exposed configuration.
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior or release operations changed.

## Security-sensitive changes

List changes to authentication, IPC, storage, network access, dependencies, GitHub Actions, signing, or release publishing. Write `None` when this does not apply. Never paste a secret into this field.
